an3.70:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati, pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
an3.70:1.3: atha kho visākhā migāramātā tadahuposathe yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho visākhaṃ migāramātaraṃ bhagavā etadavoca :
an3.70:1.4: handa kuto nu tvaṃ visākhe, āgacchasi divā divassāti?
an3.70:2.5: seyyathāpi visākhe, gopālako sāyanhasamayaṃ sāmikānaṃ gāvo nīyātetvā iti paṭisaṃcikkhati :
an3.70:2.6: ajja kho gāvo amukasmiñca amukasmiñca padese cariṃsu, amukasmiñca amukasmiñca padese pānīyāni apaṃsu,
an3.70:2.7: svedāni gāvo amukasmiñca amukasmiñca padese carissanti, amukasmiñca amukasmiñca padese pānīyāni pivissantīti.
an3.70:2.8: evameva kho visākhe, idhekacco uposathiko iti paṭisaṃcikkhati :
an3.70:2.9: ahaṃ khvajja idañcidañca khādanīyaṃ khādiṃ. idañcidañca bhojanīyaṃ bhuñjiṃ.
an3.70:2.10: svedānāhaṃ idañcidañca khādanīyaṃ khādissāmi, idañcidañca bhojanīyaṃ bhuñjissāmīti.
an3.70:2.11: so tena lobhena abhijjhāsahagatena cetasā divasaṃ atināmeti.
an3.70:2.13: evaṃ upavuttho kho visākhe, gopālakuposatho na mahapphalo hoti na mahānisaṃso na mahājutiko na mahāvipphāro.
an3.70:3.4: ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa, ye puratthimāya disāya pāṇā paraṃ yojanasataṃ, tesu daṇḍaṃ nikkhipāhi,
an3.70:3.5: ye pacchimāya disāya pāṇā paraṃ yojanasataṃ, tesu daṇḍaṃ nikkhipāhi:
an3.70:3.6: ye uttarāya disāya pāṇā paraṃ yojanasataṃ, tesu daṇḍaṃ nikkhipāhi,
an3.70:3.7: ye dakkhiṇāya disāya pāṇā paraṃ yojanasataṃ, tesu daṇḍaṃ nikkhipāhīti.
an3.70:3.8: iti ekaccānaṃ pāṇānaṃ anuddayāya anukampāya samādapenti, ekaccānaṃ pāṇānaṃ nānuddayāya nānukampāya samādapenti.
an3.70:3.10: ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa, sabbacelāni nikkhipitvā evaṃ vadehi :
an3.70:3.11: nāhaṃ kvacana kassaci kiñcanattasmiṃ. na ca mama kvacana katthaci kiñcana tātthiti.
an3.70:3.24: iti yasmiṃ samaye sacce samādapetabbā musāvāde tasmiṃ samaye samādapenti.
an3.70:3.26: so tassā rattiyā accayena bhoge adinnaññeva paribhuñjati.
an3.70:3.29: evaṃ upavuttho kho visākhe, nigaṇṭhuposatho na mahapphalo hoti na mahānisaṃso na mahājutiko na mahāvipphāro.
an3.70:4.2: upakkiliṭṭhassa visākhe, cittassa uppakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:4.3: kathañca visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa uppakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:4.5: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
an3.70:4.6: tassa tathāgataṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmojjaṃ uppajjati. ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti. seyyathāpi visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa sīsassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:5.1: kathañca visākhe, uppakkiliṭṭhassa sīsassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:5.2: kakkañca paṭicca mattikañca paṭicca udakañca paṭicca purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca. evaṃ kho visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa sīsassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:5.3: evamevaṃ kho visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:6.1: kathañca visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti :
an3.70:6.3: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
an3.70:6.4: tassa tathāgataṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmujjaṃ uppajjati. ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:6.6: ariyasāvako brahmuposathaṃ upavasati, brahmunā saddhiṃ saṃvasati. brahmaṃ cassa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati. pāmujjaṃ uppajjati. ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:6.7: evaṃ kho visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:7.1: upakkiliṭṭhassa visākhe, cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:7.2: kathañca visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:7.4: svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
an3.70:7.5: tassa dhammaṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti. seyyathāpi visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa kāyassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:8.1: kathañca visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa kāyassa ukkamena pariyodapanā hoti :
an3.70:8.2: sottiñca paṭicca cuṇṇañca paṭicca, udakañca paṭicca, purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca.
an3.70:8.3: evaṃ kho visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa kāyassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:8.4: evameva kho visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:9.1: kathañca visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti :
an3.70:9.3: svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo …pe… paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
an3.70:9.4: tassa dhammaṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:9.5: ayaṃ vuccati visākhe, ariyasāvako dhammuposathaṃ upavasati, dhammena saddhiṃ saṃvasati, dhammaṃ cassa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:9.6: evaṃ kho visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:10.1: upakkiliṭṭhassa visākhe, cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:10.2: kathañca visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti :
an3.70:10.4: supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ujupaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ñāyapaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, sāmīcipaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā esa bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho āhuneyyo pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇiyyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
an3.70:10.5: tassa saṅghaṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati. pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā. te pahīyanti. seyyathāpi visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa vatthassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:11.1: kathañca visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa vatthassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti :
an3.70:11.2: usumañca paṭicca, khārañca paṭicca, gomayañca paṭicca, udakañca paṭicca, purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca.
an3.70:11.3: evaṃ kho visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa vatthassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:11.4: evameva kho visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:12.1: kathañca visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti :
an3.70:12.3: supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
an3.70:12.4: tassa saṅghaṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:12.5: ayaṃ vuccati visākhe, ariyasāvako saṅghuposathaṃ upavasati, saṅghena saddhiṃ saṃvasati, saṅghaṃ cassa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:12.6: evaṃ kho visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:13.1: upakkiliṭṭhassa visākhe, cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:13.2: kathañca visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti :
an3.70:13.3: idha visākhe, ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni acchiddāni asabalāni akammāsāni bhujissāni viññuppasatthāni aparāmaṭṭhāni samādhisaṃvattanikāni.
an3.70:13.4: tassa sīlaṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti, seyyathāpi visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa ādāsassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:14.1: kathañca visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa ādāsassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti :
an3.70:14.2: telañca paṭicca, chārikañca paṭicca, vālaṇḍukañca paṭicca, purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca.
an3.70:14.3: evaṃ kho visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa ādāsassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:14.4: evameva kho visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:15.1: kathañca visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti :
an3.70:15.2: idha visākhe, ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikāni.
an3.70:15.3: tassa sīlaṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:15.4: ayaṃ vuccati visākhe, ariyasāvako sīlūposathaṃ upavasati, sīlena saddhiṃ saṃvasati, sīlaṃ cassa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā, te pahīyanti.
an3.70:15.5: evaṃ kho visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:16.1: upakkiliṭṭhassa visākhe, cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:16.2: kathañca visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:16.4: santi devatā cātummahārājikā santi devā tāvatiṃsā, santi devā yāmā …pe… tusitā - nimmāṇaratino - paranimmitavasavattino, santi devā brahmakāyikā, santi devā tatuttariṃ,
an3.70:16.5: yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā. mayhampi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati.
an3.70:16.6: yathārūpena sīlena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpaṃ sīlaṃ saṃvijjati.
an3.70:16.7: yathārūpena sutena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpaṃ sutaṃ saṃvijjati.
an3.70:16.8: yathārūpena cāgena samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpo cāgo saṃvijjati.
an3.70:16.9: yathārūpāya paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatīti.
an3.70:16.10: tassa attano ca tāsaṃ ca devatānaṃ saddhañca sīlañca sutañca cāgañca paññañca anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti. seyyathāpi visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa jātarūpassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:17.1: kathaṃ ca visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa jātarūpassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:17.2: ukkañca paṭicca, loṇañca paṭicca, gerukañca paṭicca, nālisaṇḍāsañca paṭicca, purisassa ca tajjaṃ vāyāmaṃ paṭicca.
an3.70:17.3: evaṃ kho visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa jātarūpassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:17.4: evameva kho visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:18.1: kathañca visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti :
an3.70:18.3: santi devā cātummahārājikā …pe… santi devā tatuttariṃ.
an3.70:18.4: yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati.
an3.70:18.8: paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayhampi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatīti.
an3.70:18.9: tassa attano ca tāsañca devatānaṃ saddhañca sīlañca sutañca cāgañca paññañca anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:18.10: ayaṃ vuccati visākhe, ariyasāvako devatuposathaṃ upavasati, devatāhi saddhiṃ saṃvasati, devatā cassa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmujjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.
an3.70:18.11: evaṃ kho visākhe, upakkiliṭṭhassa cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.
an3.70:19.1: sa kho so visākhe, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati :
an3.70:19.2: yāvajīvaṃ arahanto pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā nihitadaṇḍā nihitasatthā lajjī dayāpannā sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharanti.
an3.70:19.3: ahampajja imañca rattiṃ imañca divasaṃ pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharāmi.
an3.70:19.4: imināpahaṃ aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati.
an3.70:20.1: yāvajīvaṃ arahanto adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭiviratā dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī, athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharanti.
an3.70:20.2: ahampajja imañca rattiṃ imañca divasaṃ adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī, athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharāmi.
an3.70:20.3: imināpahaṃ aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati.
an3.70:21.1: yāvajīvaṃ arahanto abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī ārācārī viratā methunā gāmadhammā.
an3.70:21.2: ahampajja imañca rattiṃ imañca divasaṃ abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
an3.70:21.3: imināpahaṃ aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati.
an3.70:22.1: yāvajīvaṃ arahanto musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭiviratā saccavādī saccasandhā thetā paccayikā avisaṃvādakā lokassa.
an3.70:22.2: ahampajja imañca rattiṃ imañca divasaṃ musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa.
an3.70:22.3: imināpahaṃ aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati.
an3.70:23.1: yāvajīvaṃ arahanto surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānaṃ pahāya surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā.
an3.70:23.2: ahampajja imañca rattiṃ imañca divasaṃ surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānaṃ pahāya surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato.
an3.70:23.3: imināpahaṃ aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati.
an3.70:24.1: yāvajīvaṃ arahanto ekabhattikā rattūparatā viratā vikālabhojanā.
an3.70:24.2: ahampajja imañca rattiṃ imañca divasaṃ ekabhattiko rattūparato virato vikālabhojanā.
an3.70:24.3: imināpi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati.
an3.70:25.2: ahampajja imañca rattiṃ imañca divasaṃ naccagītavāditavisūkadassanamālāgandhavilepanadhāraṇamaṇḍanavibhūsanaṭṭhānā paṭivirato.
an3.70:25.3: imināpahaṃ aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati.
an3.70:26.1: yāvajīvaṃ arahanto uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭiviratā nīcaseyyaṃ kappenti. mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā.
an3.70:26.2: ahampajja imañca rattiṃ imañca divasaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭivirato nīcaseyyaṃ kappemi. mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā.
an3.70:26.3: imināpahaṃ aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissati.
an3.70:27.2: evaṃ upavuttho kho visākhe, ariyūposatho mahapphalo hoti. mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro.
an3.70:28.1: kīva mahapphalo hoti. kīva mahānisaṃso kīva mahājutiko kīva mahāvipphāro.
an3.70:28.2: seyyathāpi visākhe, yo imesaṃ soḷasannaṃ mahājanapadānaṃ pahūtasattaratanānaṃ issariyādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreyya, seyyathidaṃ :
an3.70:28.3: aṅgānaṃ, magadhānaṃ, kāsīnaṃ, kosalānaṃ, vajjīnaṃ, mallānaṃ, cetīnaṃ, vaṅgānaṃ, kurūnaṃ, pañcālānaṃ, macchānaṃ, sūrasenānaṃ, assakānaṃ, avantīnaṃ, gandhārānaṃ, kambojānaṃ, aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatassa uposathassa etassa kalaṃ nāgghati soḷasiṃ.
an3.70:28.5: kapaṇaṃ visākhe, mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāya.
an3.70:29.1: yāni visākhe, mānusakāni paññāsa vassāni, cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo
an3.70:29.4: tena saṃvaccharena pañcavassasatāni cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an3.70:29.5: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ visākhe, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco itthī vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
an3.70:29.6: idaṃ kho panetaṃ visākhe, sandhāya bhāsitaṃ
an3.70:29.7: kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbaṃ sukhaṃ upanidhāya.
an3.70:30.1: yaṃ visākhe, mānusakaṃ vassasataṃ, tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ eso eko rattindivo.
an3.70:30.4: tena saṃvaccharena dibbaṃ vassasahassaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ.
an3.70:30.5: ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ visākhe, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco itthī vā puriso vā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasitvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjeyya.
